text: Upstream demand data source failure :: The external demand telemetry source became unavailable or returned intermittent timeouts/5xx errors during the window, causing ingestion's demand pull/consume requests to fail. :: Fault originates in service:gridcast:grid-telemetry, the external vendor feeding demand data to ingestion.

Ingestion service deployment/config fault :: A bad rollout or configuration change to the ingestion service introduced an error in the demand ingestion path and recovered after rollback or restart. :: Fault originates in service:gridcast:ingestion itself.

Database dependency failure :: Postgres was degraded—connection pool exhaustion, slow/locked queries, or write failures—so ingestion could not persist demand records. :: Fault originates in service:gridcast:postgres.

Upstream demand data contract mismatch :: Demand payload schema or values changed unexpectedly and failed ingestion's validation/parsing, causing demand records to be rejected. :: Fault originates in service:gridcast:grid-telemetry due to malformed demand data.

Ingestion pod resource exhaustion :: The active ingestion pod hit CPU or memory limits or OOMKilled during a demand data spike, causing transient ingestion errors until it recovered or was rescheduled. :: Fault originates in k8s:gridcast:pod:ingestion-75cb4c9d78-ppfgf.
